title: pivot_table: reshape grouped values into a pivot table
description: Create a pivot table using index columns, an optional columns field, a value column, and an aggregation. Use this when the user asks for a cross-tab, matrix, or pivoted summary.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Columns that remain as row keys.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Column whose values become pivoted output columns.

parameters.name: agg
parameters.description: Aggregation: sum, mean, count, min, max.

rag_note: If index, columns, values, or aggregation are missing, ask for clarification because pivot_table has multiple structural interpretations.
